description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio as a percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot displays five lines representing different SepLLM configurations: the purple line with star markers and a solid style represents an unspecified configuration, starting at 100% and remaining steady; the orange line with square markers and a solid style represents SepLLM (n=64), increasing from approximately 98.5% to 100% between 1e7 and 3e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing; the blue line with triangle markers and a solid style represents SepLLM (n=128), rising from around 97% to 100% between 1e7 and 2e8 TFLOPs, then gradually decreasing to around 99%; the green line with diamond markers and a solid style represents SepLLM (n=64, H), increasing from about 98% to 100% between 1e7 and 2e8 TFLOPs, followed by a slight decline; and the red line with circle markers and a solid style represents SepLLM (n=64, H/T), starting at around 94%, rising sharply to approximately 98.5% between 1e7 and 3e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuating between 98.5% and 99%.
